verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at floot.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary. The docs also cite an llms-full.txt and agent-facing pages such as 'What your AI can do', which lists tools like get_logs, query_database and create_checkpoint, so an agent has machine-readable material to work from. Missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (docs.md returns 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of how agents use these files.
